text.text_excerpt: I had to try southern fried chicken but wasn't able to go to a sit down restaurant. I was walking on bourbon street and stopped by this small location. It was busy, filled with drunks and playing loud pop and dance music, so I went in! They have several meals starting at $10 bucks and going up. They come with good fries and a honey glazed biscuit. They also have alcoholic slushies to choose from, I got green apple. I will say this is the best chicken I have eaten yet, coming from a chain that's saying a lot. It was tender and juicy and delicious and so were the fries and biscuit. My green apple slushy was good but didn't pack an alcoholic punch.

There are lots of Willie's around the city and it's one of the first places that came up in our Yelp search with fairly consistent ratings, fast food, and convenient to our hotel so we decided to roll with it. We ordered a 4-pc basket of chicken which came with fries and a biscuit. The biscuit was pretty burnt in a couple of places. The chicken basket had a good sized wing, thigh, drumstick, and breast. Honestly the chicken was pretty darn good and it was blazing hot in temperature, as were the fries. We had a Hurricane Willie (Bacardi Rum drink) and it was definitely strong, so I was glad to share! You will see a few of these in the French Quarter especially on Bourbon Street. Surprisingly the girls in my group ate here on more than one occasion during our bachelorette celebration weekend. I found it to be perfect after a day full of walking, drinking and dancing. I had the 3 piece fried chicken meal which comes with fries and a biscuit. The chicken was fried hot and fresh which was perfect for me. The chicken was well seasoned and flavorful. I would probably recommend sitting down to eat because I didn't and trying to eat hot chicken as a I walked down Bourbon Street was not the easiest feat.
